lesson: The trade failed because the bearish structural breakdown was treated as a continuation signal rather than a potential Wyckoff Spring or localized liquidity sweep. The system correctly identified the bearish trend but failed to account for the high probability of a mean-reversion bounce at key psychological support levels.
adjustment: Require a confirmed bearish retest of the broken $59,000 support level as resistance before entering any further short positions.
methodology_flag: Trust Wyckoff accumulation/distribution phases more than pure structural trend alignment during extreme fear sentiment.
